recognize_zh: 四張口唇照片：A 圖唇部白色細網狀角化紋（lichenoid change）；B 圖唇緣紅腫、糜爛並見舌背白色苔蘚樣斑塊；C 圖唇部與唇緣紅斑合併舌面變化；D 圖唇部脫屑、結痂的唇炎。唇部苔蘚樣變化與糜爛是慢性移植物抗宿主病（cGVHD）口腔侵犯的表現。
features: A: fine white reticular (lichenoid) hyperkeratotic striae on the lower lip vermilion
B: erythematous, eroded lip margins with a white lichenoid plaque-like change on the dorsal tongue
C: erythema and small erosions along the lip vermilion border with patchy changes of the tongue surface
D: cheilitis with scaling, crusting and white keratotic flakes on erythematous lips
describe_en: Composite clinical photographs of the lips in chronic graft-versus-host disease. Panel A shows fine white reticular hyperkeratotic striae on the vermilion, a lichenoid pattern. Panels B and C show erythema and erosions of the lip margins, with lichenoid white changes on the tongue in B. Panel D shows cheilitis with scaling, crusting and keratotic flakes. Lichen planus-like changes of the oral mucosa are diagnostic features of chronic GVHD by NIH criteria, whereas erythema and erosions alone are distinctive but not diagnostic.

ddx.vs: Clinical and histologic appearance can be identical, so distinction depends on the history of allogeneic transplantation and other organ manifestations of cGVHD.
HSV produces clustered vesicles that ulcerate with scalloped borders and is confirmed by PCR or viral culture, rather than reticular white striae.
Pseudomembranous candidiasis forms white plaques that wipe off leaving erythematous mucosa and shows hyphae on smear.
Mucositis occurs early after conditioning with diffuse ulceration, and lacks lichenoid striae or late onset.

captions: A: Lichenoid white striae on lip vermilion
